I tell you, this man, rather than the Pharisee, went home justified. For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but the one who humbles himself will be exalted.”

The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
Pursue peace with everyone, as well as holiness, without which no one will see the Lord.

He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.

This is to My Fatherʼs glory, that you bear much fruit, proving yourselves to be My disciples.

so that you may be blameless and pure, children of God without fault in a crooked and perverse generation, in which you shine as lights in the world

so that the righteous standard of the law might be fulfilled in us, who do not walk according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.

“Make every effort to enter through the narrow door. For many, I tell you, will try to enter and will not be able.

crossrefs.text: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love our brothers. The one who does not love remains in death.
Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that eternal life does not reside in a murderer.
If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
And we have this commandment from Him: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.
You shall not murder.
If anyone claims to be in the light but hates his brother, he is still in the darkness.
“Be angry, yet do not sin.” Do not let the sun set upon your anger,
and do not give the devil a foothold.

crossrefs.text: For all that is in the world—the desires of the flesh, the desires of the eyes, and the pride of life—is not from the Father but from the world.
Do not lust in your heart for her beauty or let her captivate you with her eyes.

You shall not commit adultery.
For if you live according to the flesh, you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
You shall not covet your neighborʼs house. You shall not covet your neighborʼs wife, or his manservant or maidservant, or his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.”
Put to death, therefore, the components of your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, which is idolatry.
